subject: BluePeak preferred vendor form — PO mapping for per-token billing
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@bluepeak.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Preferred vendor form — billing format concerns

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks for the proposal and the pricing scenarios. Procurement reviewed the preferred vendor form (attached) and we have two blocking items from finance:

1) The form requires PO line items with fixed unit descriptions and unit price. Our AP system cannot accept a per-token/usage variable invoice line item.
2) We need a clear mapping of whatever you bill to a line item in our PO (tax code, GL account, and SKU/description).

BluePeak is willing to sign a 12-month relationship, but finance insists on either: a) committed monthly spend buckets represented as PO line items, or b) a 'not-to-exceed' fixed cap on the PO with monthly reconciliation to actual usage.

Can Redwood provide a PO-friendly version of the pricing table that maps token estimates to monthly line items we can put on the form?

Attached: BluePeak_PreferredVendorForm.pdf

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement needs this to route the PO for approval by Friday.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Director, Procurement
BluePeak Inc.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@bluepeak.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Preferred vendor form — billing format concerns

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the form. Quick answers and a proposed path:

1) We bill usage-based per-token today; our invoices show line items for: model, token category (prompt/completion), and total tokens.
2) To satisfy your AP flow we can produce a PO-friendly mapping: a) committed monthly token buckets as discrete PO line items (e.g., "Hosted API - Committed Tokens - Tier A") with a committed monthly price, plus a reconciliation line for overage calculated at the agreed per-token rate; or b) a single "Not-to-Exceed" PO line with monthly reconciliation and crediting in the subsequent invoice cycle.

I've attached: Redwood_PO_T&Cs_v2.pdf and a short pricing_scenarios.xlsx that shows three mapping options (monthly commit, quarterly commit with smoothing, and NTE cap).

Two asks: can you confirm whether BluePeak's AP system requires separate GL codes per line item (we can include them in the PO line descriptions), and whether the preferred vendor form allows attachments (we can include our mapping appendix as an addendum).

If helpful, I'm happy to get on a 30-minute call with your AP lead and legal to walk through the mapping. Proposed times: Thu 4/8 10am PT or Fri 4/9 9am PT.

Short-term, we can draft language that translates per-token to committed monthly line items and include a reconciliation section describing how overage is invoiced/credited.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: Redwood_PO_T&Cs_v2.pdf, pricing_scenarios.xlsx

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@bluepeak.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com, legal@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-04-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Preferred vendor form — billing format concerns

Ben — thanks for the quick response and the scenarios. A few clarifications from BluePeak finance/legal:

- Our AP system can accept an "overage" mechanism but only if the PO contains a primary committed line with a fixed unit price and an explicit overage rate and calculation method.
- GL codes: yes, each line item must list the GL code (we can provide).
- Attachments: the preferred vendor form accepts attachments but procurement will only route a PO that has line items visible in the form itself; attachments are supplemental.

If Redwood can provide a one-page PO appendix mapping your standard invoice fields to the PO line item format and provide sample language for the reconciliation clause, we can move this quickly.

One more ask: because your pricing is usage-based, can you provide a conservative token-to-USD estimate for each tier in the spreadsheet (the 'expected monthly charge' and 'max monthly exposure' columns) so finance can see the liability profile?

Thanks — if you can send a draft PO appendix by EOD tomorrow we can try to route it through our approvers.

Regards,
Sarah

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: BluePeak preferred vendor form — PO language exception?

Team — looping you in. BluePeak procurement pushed back on per-token invoices because their AP needs PO line items. They asked for: (a) a PO appendix that maps committed monthly token buckets to a PO line item with a fixed monthly price and explicit overage math; and (b) conservative USD exposure estimates for each tier.

Options I see:
- Standard approach: Draft an appendix that presents 3 committed tiers mapped to monthly fixed amounts (we keep per-token invoicing for reconciliation). This is operationally straightforward and aligns with our existing practice (monthly commits + overage).
- Exception approach: Agree to Redwood offering a 'Not-To-Exceed' PO with a capped monthly amount for the first 3 months while we track usage and then normalize billing. This reduces flexibility and some upside.

Commercial ask from BluePeak is for a 12-month arrangement. I'm proposing we offer a 12-month commit with tiered pricing and up to a 15% off-list discount on the committed volume if they sign the 12-month appendix. Approve providing the PO appendix draft and up to 15% discount?

Please advise: 1) Approve appendix + discount up to 15%? 2) Any legal concerns with including GL codes and sample invoice mapping in the appendix? 3) Approve scheduling a short call with BluePeak AP/legal to finalize?

Attached: pricing_scenarios.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@bluepeak.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Preferred vendor form — PO mapping for per-token billing

Hi Sarah — appreciate the detail and the timeline. Per our internal alignment (copied Lauren / Rishi / Marissa), please find attached a draft one-page PO appendix and three example committed tiers that translate estimated tokens into fixed monthly line items plus an overage calculation. High-level summary:

- Tier A (small): 10M committed tokens / month — committed monthly price $6,000 — overage $0.0008 per token
- Tier B (medium): 50M committed tokens / month — committed monthly price $25,000 — overage $0.0006 per token
- Tier C (enterprise): 200M committed tokens / month — committed monthly price $85,000 — overage $0.00045 per token

We included a conservative "max monthly exposure" column in the attached spreadsheet (pricing_scenarios.xlsx) assuming 25% over-usage versus commit. We also included a short reconciliation clause that can be pasted into the PO:

"Redwood to invoice monthly against committed PO line items; any usage above the committed tokens will be invoiced at the agreed overage rate. Any charges invoiced in excess of the PO cap will be credited on the next invoice, provided usage and invoices are reconciled within 30 days."

We can insert BluePeak's GL codes into the PO line item text; please send them back with the form. If this is acceptable, we are fine with offering a 12-month committed appendix at a 15% discount on the committed volume for the selected tier.

Next steps: 1) Sarah — can you confirm which tier BluePeak wants to put on the PO? 2) If yes, we will finalize the appendix and return a signed copy for your procurement routing.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_T&Cs_v2.pdf, pricing_scenarios.xlsx, BluePeak_PO_Appendix_DRAFT.pdf

Looking forward — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if it'd help.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
